disclaimer: Not a release certification. All gates are pending until independently verified evidence is recorded and reviewed.

gates.title: Real Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini and Ollama integration
gates.acceptance: Record opt-in real generation, verification, approval, receipts and cost with safe test keys for each adapter.

gates.title: Gmail OAuth and Microsoft 365 mail
gates.acceptance: Prove authorization-code PKCE, minimal scopes, refresh/revocation, Mail.Read/Mail.Send, retry and permission isolation.

gates.title: Isolated Claude Code / Codex execution
gates.acceptance: Disposable sandbox with timeout/network limits, diff and project tests, explicit human approval, optional PR; no host execution.

gates.title: Security, retention, recovery and key management
gates.acceptance: Independent review and tenant/SSRF/CSRF/approval negative tests, key recovery/rotation, data retention/export/deletion and full restore drill.

gates.title: Clean install and upgrade on Windows, macOS and Linux
gates.acceptance: Real Docker startup, onboarding, persistent restart, upgrade and rollback on supported operating systems.

gates.title: Fair 300-task independently reviewed autonomy benchmark
gates.acceptance: 300 reviewed tasks with 30 traps and three repeats, matched Select/Paperclip/baseline cases; publish raw results and uncertainty.

gates.title: Public release dry-run and operational validation
gates.acceptance: Verified green CI on release SHA, secrets scan across Git history, redacted live workflow, migration/rollback notes and reviewed release notes.

gates.title: First-run UX parity, responsiveness and accessibility
gates.acceptance: Measured five first-use flows, keyboard and WCAG 2.2 AA audit and responsive checks on supported viewport sizes.
